title: NHM Dhamtari Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for 38 Staff Nurse
description: National Health Mission Dhamtari (NHM Dhamtari) has announced the official notification for 2026. To fill vacancies for 38 ANM, Medical Officers, Nursing Officers, Staff Nurses, Dental Assistants, and Other Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in ANM, B.Sc Nursing, BAMS, BDS, BHMS, BPT, BUMS, Diploma, GNM, M.Sc, and 12th can use this opportunity and apply for the NHM Dhamtari Notification 2026 .
